KB Media Equine is an equestrian YouTube channel dedicated to authentic horse-world storytelling, behind-the-scenes barn life, and real conversations from every level of the sport.

We create cinematic equestrian documentaries, educational features, and long-form interviews with riders, trainers, owners, breeders, and adult amateurs. From hunter/jumper, dressage, and eventing to everyday barn life, our content highlights the passion, challenges, mental health, training journeys, and business of the equestrian industry.

Whether you’re an adult amateur rider, competitive equestrian, or lifelong horse lover, KB Media Equine brings you inside the ingate to experience the sport beyond the show ring — the preparation, pressure, wins, losses, and the community that makes it all worth it.

Subscribe for weekly equestrian content, horse industry insights, and stories that connect the equestrian community — because horses are more than a sport, they’re a way of life.
